contentItem.title: 等列比：消去中项后的两端比例
contentItem.englishTitle: A ratio ex aequali arises when, there being several magnitudes and another set equal to them in multitude which taken two and two are in the same proportion, as the first is to the last among the first magnitudes, so is the first to the last among the second magnitudes; Or, in other words, it means taking the extreme terms by virtue of the removal of the intermediate terms.

surfaces.text: A ratio ex aequali arises when, there being several magnitudes and another set equal to them in multitude which taken two and two are in the same proportion, as the first is to the last among the first magnitudes, so is the first to the last among the second magnitudes; Or, in other words, it means taking the extreme terms by virtue of the removal of the intermediate terms.
等同比产生时,如果有多个等同数值,而两个等同数值,两个等同比例相同,那么第一个等同数值中第一个等同最后一个等同数值,等于第二个等同数值中第一个等同最后一个;换言之,这意味着通过删除中间条件来采用极端条件。（相关点与线段：A）
